text:
Alex K.: quick status check — AP-SOUTHEAST-2 region expansion. Need to confirm routing policy owner, KMS/residency owner, and any remaining infra PRs. Target: lock rollout plan by EOD.
Maria V.: I own the routing policy configs for new regions. I pushed initial draft here: https://git.internal.redwood/infrastructure/routing/pulls/27 — still needs review for cross-zone failover.
TJ: KMS/residency is on infra-sre side; Sasha is the current lead for KMS onboarding. @Sasha R. can you confirm key access model and whether HSM is required for APAC?
Sasha R.: confirming — HSM not required by default for this customer cohort, but enterprise customers may need BYOK. Current plan: use regional KMS with key replication disabled (residency strict). I'll skip replication unless security requests it.
Maria V.: routing fallback question: do we prefer eu-west-1 or us-west for cold fallback? cost/latency tradeoffs. My vote is eu-west-1 for latency to APAC customers in EU/ME customers? open to input.
TJ: prefer us-west for cost but latency hit for APAC. If we have strict residency for APAC customer, fallback should still respect residency — so fallback must be to same region group or failover to a compatible model that doesn't store customer data. Need a policy.
Sasha R.: +1 on residency-aware fallback. Proposed policy in doc: `fallback_strategy: FAIL_IF_RESIDENCY_VIOLATED` unless explicitly allowed by policy exception. See snippet:```yaml
routing:
  prefer_region: ap-southeast-2
  fallback: eu-west-1
  residency: strict
  fallback_policy: FAIL_IF_RESIDENCY_VIOLATED
```
Liz C.: security/compliance note — for APAC we need 7yrs audit log retention for some customers. Make sure the Console retention settings and S3 lifecycle are set. Filing a short checklist: 1) KMS key policy 2) Audit retention 3) Data plane ACLs.
Alex K.: thanks. Can we enumerate action owners & PRs? I want a single list to share with product.
Maria V.: owners list (w/ PRs): - Routing policy: Maria V. (PR https://git.internal.redwood/infrastructure/routing/pulls/27) - Route tests & canary: TJ (PR https://git.internal.redwood/deploy/canaries/pulls/142) - KMS/residency: Sasha R. (KMS onboarding PR https://git.internal.redwood/infra/kms/pulls/51) - Compliance checklist: Liz C. (ticket SEC-1183)
TJ: I still have one open item — automated failover needs a small tweak so canaries don't cross-residency. Patch here: https://git.internal.redwood/deploy/canaries/pulls/144 — reviewers: @Maria V., @Sasha R.
Sasha R.: I reviewed PR 144 and left one comment re: header propagation for region tag. Will push a fix today.
Infra-Bot: deploy-check: canary pipeline for ap-southeast-2 shows 2 failing integration tests: routing-e2e::zone-assert and kms-auth::token-rotation. See CI run https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/9823
Maria V.: noted. I'll pick up the routing-e2e failure — seems like a test env DNS mismatch.
Liz C.: pinging @security on the audit retention question — security, can you confirm SEC-1183 owner?
Oncall Bot: SEC-1183 assigned to Security Team. SLA: 72 hours for initial response.
Alex K.: great — final ask: please add estimated completion time next to each PR owner in this thread. I'll assemble a handoff doc for Product.
Maria V.: ETA for routing PR: EOD today (in review).
TJ: canary patch ETA: tomorrow morning PST.
Sasha R.: KMS PR ETA: EOD tomorrow after I push header fix.
Liz C.: compliance checklist ETA: Monday COB — need a short review from security.
Alex K.: solid — thanks everyone. I'll share the roundup with Product and Ops in ~30m. If anything blocks, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
